description: Preliminary logical teacher estimates for 24 small synthetic immutable final changes.
reviewNotes: Single host-AI teacher review mapped by change-teacher-plan-generator/0.1.0; no independent correction or adjudication. Candidate totals were observed during fixture-invariant verification before this policy was authored, so this is disclosed weak supervision rather than a blind label claim. Category budgets were reasoned from the final synthetic behavior and frozen without fitting seed priors, validation outcomes, test outcomes, or preferred WAPE.
